author: omidfxt
text:
Hey Guys

here is a brief explanation on how the market works and how the main player try to win the game

Nothing is new here, all had been said thorough RTM. Just want to share it with my friends as a remind:

Before you want to join the game you HAVE TO know who are your enemies and how they play the game!

Why you have to know them?

Just a simple logic:

Because they are the main players in the game and the ones who are changing the market conditions

Certainly they are in the market to make money for their investors and absolutely themselves!

So you can’t be a good player if you don’t know the games rules and what there are looking for!

As you know nobody isn’t in the market just for the sake of God!

All the players in this game are looking for MONEY!

The same reason you are here! Aren’t you? : )

Here we can specify Forex players:

(image resource;forextraderportal.com)

All the players above want to increase their capitals and made more money

So as a simple logic there isn’t such a condition for everyone to profit from the market

As In the real world if you want to sell something you have to find
someone to buy it from you and if there isn’t any buyers so your
property doesn’t have any value!

And if there are lots of buyers, there will be a completion between them
 to owe your property so the value of your property will raise and you
can sell it in a higher price!

It is the same in the market. It is all about supply and demand!

Ok. Let’s get back to the main players in the market

They are all in a competition and want to make money from the market

But between them there some BIG GUYS that can make more money and no ones is going to stop them!

Why? Simple because they have the money and certainly the power!

If they want they can smash everyone on their way!

And they do! Because they want it all!

So how can they do it?

Again simple! They cheat on other ones! And if they want the money they have to do it!!

Because for example if they want to sell loads of something they have to
 have loads of buyers for their sell orders. That simple!

Ok. Now we know who are they and what they want. Great!

Now let’s see how it’s possible for them to achieve their goals?

First of all let’s talk about one of the participators in the market:

Retail Traders!

Most of the time retail traders are known as individual traders that are
 ordinary people that are trying to make money from the market(and in
95% of the time they can’t!)

But I think we can call someone as a retail trader that is not a BIG GUYS!

An individual trader, an institute traders or even a bank trader that is not in the BIG GUYS band can be a retailer!!

Now we are familiar with the retailers that are an easy competitor for BIG GUYS!

What are the BGs(Big Guys)’s plan for them?

Simple again! They interest everyone into trading and teach them how to do it wrong!

Brokers are some of their best friends!

Brokers make the deal and profit from the spreads and commissions! Easy money for them !

So if they have enough customers they can make more money.

Ok. Simple work! Just try to advertise for trading and show it as simple as possible!

They try to provide sexy platforms and apps for trading and lots of artistic indicator!

You can interest everybody into trading just by a simple indicator and a beautiful trend line or channel!

They translate their false trading strategies that are prepared very
smart into many language and give them to you just for free! Yeah they
really love retailers in the deepest part of their hearts!

They show you: oh look at this beautiful channel. Every time price hit
one side, it will react there and will go to the other side. Also look
at that beautiful MACD, RSI, … indicator that is telling you when to
trade and when to exit!

So amazing. Who is enough silly not to start trading after seeing this!

Absolutely no one as most of us did! : )

So let’s start with the free education and after a short period of time
we can start trading and open a live account to make the millions that
we were dreaming all the times!

Ok a good and sexy plan!

But most of the retailers don’t know who are behind the sense that are playing the games!

Smart and experienced traders teams with millions in their asset on their trading desk!

They are there for retail trader’s money and will make them confused each time!

Retailers: Damn! my stop just got hit by a few pips and then price went in my direction!

Ok. That because the lake of my understanding. I will study more and
will do it again. There is a huge amount of money right there, I can’t
give up on it simply!

That is the story that will be repeat again and again and HAS TO be repeat to full the pocket of BGs and their friends!

Just simple as always!

...........................................................................................................................................................................................

So as an advantage of knowing the main players in the market and their goals:

We as Smart retailers : ) have to be aware of all the tricks that are played in the market

As RTM told us many times, we have to try to get into the mind of the
BGs and put their hats on our heads and look at the chart as ones does!

We have to think in terms of order flow. Where BGs can fill their orders?

Where they can trap others to provide opposite positions for them to fill their orders?

RTM showed us how to see the manipulation of hope and fear and think
about the retailer’s mindset. How to see the buildings of positions and
the real movement of price and the reasons behind them

If we study all the RTM concepts they are all saying that what are BGs
doing in the market and where they are looking for trapping other
retailers

RTM is telling us always looking for signs of what the BGs are doing at
 the significant areas and emphasize on it that if we don’t see what
they are doing, there will be no trade for us!

If you seek through RTM and all the Concepts and the trades IF and
masters took you can see it clearly what is going on the market and you
will understand how to READ THE MARKET properly

This was just a brief and simple explanation of what I have learned so
far from this community and want to share it with my friends

You can read more through RTM and some very limited sources in the Internet

Know your enemies and their intentions and don't let them fool you : )

Best Regards

omid
